name: Lets Go
summary: Discount ISP brand of Concept Networks (cheap ADSL, dialup, prepaid); parent Concept Networks bought by EFTel Sept 2008; Lets Go customers migrated to EFTel Feb 2009 (EFTEL PTY LTD, ACN 073 238 178).

events.details: Customers migrated to EFTel (after Concept Networks purchase).
